message: 너와 나의 사이가, 우리 모두의 세계로.
approved_direction: Male and female silhouettes symbolize two distinct complementary forces, not a literal gender doctrine. Separated silhouettes remain within two circulating galactic arms: harmony without erasing difference. Voluntary exploration, no redirect.

scenes.event: Hold SAI lettering through the original final chord and a breath.
Existing particles move gradually into targets sampled from the approved artwork. The plate reveals over 49–58 seconds with smoothstep easing; no completed-figure hold.
The same point IDs continue outward into two spiral arms. The approved raster plate preserves anatomy before gradually dissolving as deterministic fine-grain fragments from 58 to 69 seconds.
No figures remain. The shared galaxy continues into taeguk harmony.
Continuous camera retreat overlaps both transformations so the middle never becomes a separate stopped scene.
Two additional full rotations at 46/66 of the previous speed, smoothly accelerating and slowing, driven by media time.
The same particles gradually complete a circular taeguk with two distinct complementary colors.
Quiet settling; original music repeats at native speed with crossfades, without time stretching. Exploration remains voluntary.

catalog_application.adaptation: Preserve point IDs through lettering, sampled artwork and galaxy targets. An approved raster plate preserves delicate hands and anatomy while the existing GSAP timeline owns both particle morph and plate reveal.
Seeded two-arm galaxy and 2:1 inner-to-outer angular speed in the vertex shader. Driven only by media time, not a second animation loop.

human_acceptance: User approved the generated creation-inspired styleframe. The previous crouching silhouette result was rejected. Runtime implementation is checked technically; aesthetic acceptance of its animation remains user-owned.
